notes: The ROS builder, laid out like QLab 5. A masthead shows the current row big (cue, what happens, start → end, who, where, notes and department entries) beside the show's planned end, run time and counts. Under it a timeline strip shows the whole show, a block per section; click it to jump there. A footer holds Edit / Review, the cue and section counts, the checks (✕ to fix, ⚠ to check; click to open the list), Colour, Departments, row size and the Inspector button. Inspector (⌘I) at the bottom: Basics, Timing, Departments, Notes, Colour & flag for the current row. Departments show as chips in…
